blurb: Guests take narrated 50-minute cruises on the M/V Mystic Belle, a 28' flat-bottomed river barge, to see the Vermilion River, local maritime industry, wildlife, and waterfront homes. Tours run Memorial Day through Labor Day with scheduled times and sunset cruises on weekends. The marina provides boat storage, maintenance, and dockage services.
